newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up for 3rd straight day.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up for 3rd straight day.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed up for the third straight day in high volume, boosted by strong trade in leading local bank Banco Provincial, traders said.
The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index gained 0.8 percent to end at 6,368.52 points as 37 million shares exchanged hands worth 16 billion bolivars ($34 million).

Around 18 million shares traded in Banco Provincial, which closed off 10.00 bolivars at 780.00. Traders said various clients had bought the stock, but denied the moves had been due to a selloff of financial guru George Soros's nine percent stake in the bank, Venezuela's largest.

Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya said in December it had agreed to buy a 40 percent stake in Banco Provincial by acquiring Credit Lyonnais's 17 percent share and part of leading local brewing group Polar's 40 percent holding.

Among traded issues, 32 rose, five fell and 12 closed flat. Banco Consolidado gained 67.00 bolivars to close at 621.00 on unconfirmed reports U.S. bank Chase Manhattan would buy a 20 percent stake. Among the day's other leading trades, steel company Sivensa gained 9.00 bolivars to close at 325.00.
